title: 1930s homesteader accounts of cattle mutilation on the property

tellings.quote: Our investigation has unearthed the fact that there are accounts that go back to the 1930s with the early homesteaders of bizarre cattle mutilation and other strange activity on this property.

plain: Settlers on a Utah property now known as Skinwalker Ranch reported strangely mutilated cattle and other odd happenings as far back as the 1930s. Brandon Fugal, who presents himself on the show as the ranch's owner, tells Michels that his team's investigation turned up these early homesteader accounts, without naming them, as a sign that the strangeness predates the ranch's modern fame.
